data.name: Baydaa
data.gender_notes: Baydaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'bayda', meaning 'white' or 'bright'. It is often associated with the sun and its light, symbolizing clarity, brightness, and purity. The name Baydaa carries the meaning “Sunlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Baydaa usually hope their child will grow to embody sunlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the light and clarity of spiritual enlightenment, inspiring hope and purification of the soul.
data.etymology: Baydaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sunlight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baydaa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: بيضاء
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني البياض والنور، مشتق من الفعل أبيض
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بيضاء هو مشتق من الفعل أبيض الذي يعني البياض والنور. في اللغة العربية، يرمز البياض إلى النور والسلام. وفي القرآن الكريم، نجد أن البياض يمثل النقاء والطهارة. اسم بيضاء يحمل معاني جميلة ومرتبطة بالروحانية والنور الداخلي.

in_urdu.name: بیضاء
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے سفید پن اور نور، عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ
in_urdu.long_meaning: بیضاء نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سفید پن اور نور۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نور اور روحانی صفائی کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی ثقافت میں، یہ نام لڑکیوں کے لیے مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ خوبصورتی اور اندرونی سکون کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बयदां
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है सफेद और प्रकाश, आध्यात्मिक महत्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: बयदां नाम का अर्थ है सफेद और प्रकाश, जो आध्यात्मिक शुद्धता और आंतरिक शांति का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पवित्रता और दिव्य प्रकाश से जुड़ा हुआ है। यह नाम लड़कियों के लिए चुना जाता है जो सुंदरता और सुकून की विशेषता रखती हैं।

in_pashto.name: بیضاء
in_pashto.meaning: د نوم مطلب دی سپینوالی او رڼا، د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: بیضاء نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د سپینوالی او رڼا معنی لري. په پښتنو کلتور کې، دا نوم د پاکۍ او روحاني ښکلا د نښه ګڼل کیږي. دا نوم د نجونو لپاره غوره کیږي چې د ښکلا او سولې ځانګړتیا ولري.

The name is popular across various Muslim cultures for its beautiful connotations and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Baydaa holds a rich cultural significance in Islamic tradition, particularly in relation to the Prophet Muhammad and his companions. One of the most noteworthy stories involves the wife of Prophet Muhammad, Aisha bint Abu Bakr, who was also known as Umm Baydaa (mother of Baydaa). Additionally, the name is associated with the first mosque built in Medina, known as Masjid al-Qubha, which was also referred to as Mesjid Baydaa (mosque of Baydaa).
data.spiritual_significance: The name Baydaa holds profound spiritual significance, representing the concept of spiritual purity and illumination. It is mentioned in various Islamic texts and hadiths that those who strive for knowledge and righteousness resemble the moon at its fullest, shining brightly with truth and wisdom. The name Baydaa can serve as a reminder of the importance of maintaining a clean heart and mind, and striving for knowledge and understanding in one's quest for spiritual growth.
